release_notes:
## Fixes
- Social Media exports now find the Watermark track whatever the clip is named. It previously only matched a clip named exactly "Watermark", so with any show-code naming (e.g. AT03_TPKR_WATERMARK.png) the track was never found — and because every video track gets un-muted as a baseline first, that left the watermark VISIBLE on LIVE, MARKETING and the no-watermark Social Media version alike
- Mute Master Clips no longer mutes more tracks than intended. Reference-track detection kept scanning past the first match and settled on the highest matching track below the title card instead of the first one found

## Diagnostics
- This build does NOT yet fix Mute Master Clips failing to mute. It adds logging to find out why: the nest log now reports every video track's real mute state straight out of Premiere at three points — after the un-mute/target step, after the mute step, and on the first nested episode. Run one nest with Mute Master Clips checked and send those three lines
